integrity: An exact weighted 100-state matrix construction and coefficient comparison, graph component proof, and independent brute-force small-width checks are supplied. These are computationally reproducible; no independent mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact time-fixed configurations only on three-by-N periodic strips at threshold four and N>=3; no attraction or higher-strip theorem. Older specialist enumerations may exist despite targeted searches.
title: Exact stationary-state growth on three-row cyclic-dominance tori
